Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties, on trip TRP-02822 (RYDE_X, metered fare). Distance: the policy makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure, and it is 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.20 km — an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (0.85 km is more than 20% of optimal, 0.64 km, and more than the 0.80 km absolute threshold), so a deviation is established; the trip_record's rounded 4.00 km copy is not used for the threshold because POL-RD-01 forbids it. The deviation is NOT material — 0.85 km is below 50% of optimal and below 8.0 km — so the POL-RD-06 uplift to a full refund and the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral do not arise, and on the only citable profile counters (deviation_flags_90d = 1 against completed_trips_90d = 402) no repeat pattern is established. Remedy: the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route and POL-RD-02 fixes the refund arithmetically. Charged_total = 9.28. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.20 + 0.28 x 6.0) x the 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls + 0.00 waiting time - 0.00 promo = 8.68. Refund = 9.28 - 8.68 = 0.60, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which leaves 0.60. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis floor and only 6.5% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so PARTIAL_REFUND of 0.60 is the outcome — not the whole 9.28 the claim text asks for, which is more than fifteen times what the arithmetic yields. Nothing excuses the excess: the chat log holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction and no waypoint to corroborate; both amendment timestamps are null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not displace the 3.20 km baseline; and the driver's 'Followed the app' cites no artifact and no clause, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes (zero gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage), so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration or POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. No traffic advisory covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02822-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0) and no party asserted an external traffic cause; the rider's advisory-based claim was discarded on the mechanical check and is not relied on. Finally, POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the fare carries 0.00 ERP/tolls, no airport surcharge and 0.00 waiting fee, so there is no pass-through or billing-integrity correction, finding or referral, and the 0.60 distance refund is the whole of the rider's recovery. The monetary effect (0.60) is below the 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue subject to the ordinary appeal route.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
